summary: Companies list, create/edit form dialog and company page wired to the IF-002 routes through httpClient. The list filters by name, stage (Todos, 1 to 4) and active/archived, with the filters kept in ?busca=, ?estagio= and ?arquivadas=1. It shows the empty, no-result, loading and error states. Create and edit share one form: name 2 to 80 characters, segment and sales channel required, annual revenue and CNPJ optional, CNPJ through CnpjField. Archive, restore and delete go through ConfirmDialog; the delete text shows completedCount plus the open draft. App.tsx routes empresas and empresa/:companyId to the real pages.

findings.summary: Server field errors are lost on the client: server/http/errorHandler.ts puts `fields` at error.fields (top level), but src/api/httpClient.ts (primitives unit) copies only error.details into ApiError. CompanyFormDialog reads details.fields; until this is fixed, a 400 validation_failed shows only the general message. Client validation already checks the same rules as the server.

Starting a diagnosis (POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses, IF-003) is outside this unit, which only uses IF-002. CompanyPage takes an optional `onStartDiagnosis(companyId) => Promise<{ id }>` prop. Until App.tsx passes it, the 'Começar o primeiro diagnóstico' and 'Novo diagnóstico' buttons stay hidden. 'Continuar diagnóstico' already works: it links to /diagnostico/{draftId}.

The plan wants CompanyPage to link to the latest result, but IF-002 Company has no latest completed diagnosis id. The page shows the latest stage and date as text only, with no link to /resultado/:id.

pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts was not run. The spec belongs to a sibling unit, and the backend company routes (phase-1-backend-companies) are written concurrently, so the screens were not exercised against a live API in this session. AC-dm-04/05/06 runtime evidence is deferred to integration.

evidence.result: Only IF-002 paths are used: GET/POST /api/companies (q, stage, archived), GET/PATCH /api/companies/:id, POST :id/archive, POST :id/restore, DELETE :id. Write body is { name, segment, salesChannel, annualRevenueRange|null, cnpj (14 digits)|null }, the same for create and edit.

messages.text: src/api/httpClient.ts drops the server's top-level error.fields: errorHandler sends { error: { code, message, fields } }, but ApiError keeps only error.details. Either have httpClient keep `fields` (e.g. details = error.details ?? { fields: error.fields }) or have the server nest fields under details. CompanyFormDialog already reads (error.details as { fields }).fields.

Wire CompanyPage's start buttons: in App.tsx render <CompanyPage onStartDiagnosis={(id) => diagnosesApi.startDiagnosis(id)} /> once src/api/diagnosesApi.ts exists (POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses returns the existing or a new draft { id, ... }). Until then 'Começar o primeiro diagnóstico' and 'Novo diagnóstico' are hidden.

IF-002 Company has latestStage and latestCompletedAt but no latest completed diagnosis id, so CompanyPage cannot link to /resultado/:id. Should the backend add `latestDiagnosisId`, or should the history timeline (phase 2) cover the link? Assumption: the page shows only the stage and date text for now.

Deferred checks: run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts` once phase-1-backend-companies is mounted in server/app.ts. Selectors available: data-aioson-id companies-new, companies-table, companies-empty, company-create-modal, company-edit-modal, company-create-submit, company-edit-submit, company-edit, company-archive, company-restore, company-delete, company-{archive|restore|delete}-confirm; rows have data-row-id={company.id}; the search input is #busca; filters live in ?busca=, ?estagio=1..4, ?arquivadas=1. After creating, the app goes to #/empresa/{id} (as in the prototype); after deleting from the company page, it goes to #/empresas?arquivadas=1. Restore also asks for confirmation (AC-dm-48).
listCompanies accepts the list response either as a bare array or as { companies: [...] }. stage is sent as 1..4, and archived as 'true' only when the archived list is shown.
